topics.title: 聊聊我自己
topics.subtitle: Talking about yourself
topics.examTip:
**考法** 个人信息是 PET 口语 Part 1 的固定开场：考官会依次问 What's your name? / Where do you live? / Do you work or are you a student? / What do you do (study)?，随后常问 Do you enjoy studying English? / What did you do last weekend? 这类日常与过去经历的问题。答案要用完整句并自然带出细节或理由，通常会自然用到一般现在时、现在完成时（I've been learning English for…）和一般过去时。
**场景** Part 2 的照片可能是某人在自己房间或家里的日常场景，要按「整体—人物动作—地点背景—其他细节」的顺序描述，用现在进行时和 There is/are 组织。考场上考官只说 Please tell us what you can see in the photograph，没有分项小问题，要自己按顺序说满约一分钟。Part 3 常见任务卡是帮新同学熟悉环境，要提出并回应建议、给理由，不用急着下结论。

templates.en: I live in ___ with ___.
templates.zh: 说住在哪里、和谁住

templates.en: I'm a student at ___, and my favourite subject is ___.
templates.zh: 介绍学校和喜欢的科目

templates.en: I've been learning English for ___ years because ___.
templates.zh: 说学英语多久、为什么

templates.en: Last weekend I ___, and it was ___.
templates.zh: 用过去时说上周末做了什么

part1.en: Where do you live?
part1.zh: 你住在哪里？

part1.en: I live in Hangzhou, in the east of China. It's a big city, but my flat is near a quiet lake.
part1.zh: 我住在中国东部的杭州。那是个大城市，不过我家的公寓靠近一个安静的湖。

part1.en: Do you work or are you a student?
part1.zh: 你在工作还是在上学？

part1.en: I'm a student. I'm in my second year at secondary school, and my favourite subject is science.
part1.zh: 我是学生。我在读中学二年级，最喜欢的科目是科学。

part1.en: Do you enjoy studying English?
part1.zh: 你喜欢学英语吗？

part1.en: Yes, I do, because I like watching films in English, and I can understand more of them now.
part1.zh: 喜欢，因为我爱看英文电影，而且现在能听懂的越来越多了。

part1.en: What did you do last weekend?
part1.zh: 你上周末做了什么？

part1.en: On Saturday I went cycling with my cousin, and on Sunday I stayed at home and helped my mum cook.
part1.zh: 周六我和表弟去骑车，周日我待在家里帮妈妈做饭。

part2.prompt: 描述一张照片：一个男孩在自己的房间里。说说他在做什么、房间里有什么、可能是什么时间。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a teenage boy sitting at a desk in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 照片里我能看到一个十几岁的男孩坐在他卧室的书桌前。

sentences.en: He is writing something in a notebook, and there is an open laptop next to him.
sentences.zh: 他正在笔记本上写东西，旁边放着一台打开的笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: He is wearing a green hoodie, and he has headphones around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他穿着绿色连帽衫，脖子上挂着耳机。

sentences.en: On the wall behind him, there are some posters of football players.
sentences.zh: 他身后的墙上贴着几张足球运动员的海报。

sentences.en: There is a bookshelf on the left with lots of books and a few small trophies.
sentences.zh: 左边有一个书架，放着很多书和几个小奖杯。

sentences.en: A guitar is standing in the corner next to the window, and the curtains are open.
sentences.zh: 窗边的角落立着一把吉他，窗帘是拉开的。

sentences.en: It looks like the afternoon, because the sun is shining into the room.
sentences.zh: 看起来是下午，因为阳光正照进房间。

sentences.en: The room is a bit untidy, with some clothes on the bed.
sentences.zh: 房间有点乱，床上放着几件衣服。

sentences.en: I think he is doing his homework, and he seems quite relaxed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他在做作业，而且看起来挺放松的。

part3.task: **Part 3** 你和另一位考生看一张任务卡:新同学 Mia 刚转来你们班,还不认识任何人。讨论卡片上帮她适应的办法(邀请她一起吃午饭、带她参观学校、周末组织活动、介绍学校社团、帮她补功课),说说哪个最好 —— 逐个讨论,不用急着下结论。

sentences.en: A new girl called Mia has just joined our class. How could we help her feel welcome?
sentences.zh: 一个叫 Mia 的新同学刚加入我们班。我们怎么才能让她感到受欢迎呢？

sentences.en: Well, we could invite her to have lunch with us. That's an easy way to start talking.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们可以邀请她一起吃午饭。这是个开始聊天的简单办法。

sentences.en: Yes, that's simple and friendly. We could also show her around the school on her first day.
sentences.zh: 对，简单又友好。我们还可以在她第一天带她参观学校。

sentences.en: Good idea, because she probably doesn't know where the library or the sports hall is.
sentences.zh: 好主意，因为她大概还不知道图书馆和体育馆在哪儿。

sentences.en: What about organising something at the weekend, like a trip to the cinema?
sentences.zh: 周末组织点活动怎么样，比如一起去看电影？

sentences.en: That might be too soon. She may feel shy going out with people she has just met.
sentences.zh: 那可能太快了。跟刚认识的人出去，她也许会不好意思。

sentences.en: Fair enough. Then we could tell her about the school clubs, so she meets people with the same interests.
sentences.zh: 有道理。那我们可以先跟她介绍学校的社团，这样她能认识兴趣相同的人。

sentences.en: I like that. And if she has missed some lessons, we could help her with the work.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。要是她落下了一些课，我们也可以帮她补功课。

sentences.en: True, but let's not do everything at once. Lunch and the tour are the most important on day one.
sentences.zh: 没错，不过别一下子做太多。第一天最重要的是午饭和参观。

sentences.en: I agree, and then we can mention the clubs and the weekend later, when she feels more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 同意，等她更自在了，我们再提社团和周末活动。

sentences.en: So we both think inviting her to lunch and showing her around are the best ways to start.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都觉得，邀请她吃午饭和带她参观是最好的开始。

sentences.en: Exactly. Let's talk to her tomorrow morning before the first lesson.
sentences.zh: 没错。明天早上第一节课之前我们就去找她聊聊。

topics.title: 聊聊我住的地方
topics.subtitle: Home and where I live
topics.examTip:
**考法** 住所是 PET 口语 Part 1 的常见话题：考官通常会请你说说住的地方（Tell us about the place where you live）、最喜欢哪个房间、以后想住房子还是公寓。B1 学生要用完整句并给理由，通常会自然用到 There is/are、because、比较级和 would prefer 表达偏好。
**场景** Part 2 的照片常是家里某个房间的生活场景，按人物、动作、家具物品、光线气氛的顺序描述，用现在进行时和方位词（next to / near / in the corner）组织。考场上考官只说 Please tell us what you can see in the photograph，没有分项小问题，要自己按顺序说满约一分钟。Part 3 常见任务卡是某家人的空房间做什么用，真实考试卡片说的是别人的情况，要用 they / the children could… 来讨论，逐个比较选项并给理由，意见不一致也可以，只要充分讨论。

templates.en: I live in a ___ on the ___ floor, and it has ___ rooms.
templates.zh: 说住房类型、楼层和房间数

templates.en: My favourite room is ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说最喜欢的房间并给理由

templates.en: The best thing about my area is ___.
templates.zh: 说住的地方最好的一点

templates.en: If I could change one thing about my home, I would ___.
templates.zh: 说想改变家里的什么

part1.en: Tell us about the place where you live.
part1.zh: 说说你住的地方吧。

part1.en: I live in a flat on the tenth floor. It has three bedrooms, and my room looks out over the river.
part1.zh: 我住在十楼的一套公寓里。有三间卧室，我的房间能看到外面的河。

part1.en: Which is your favourite room at home, and why?
part1.zh: 你在家里最喜欢哪个房间？为什么？

part1.en: The kitchen, because that's where we spend most of our time together as a family, especially at dinner.
part1.zh: 厨房，因为那是我们一家人待在一起时间最多的地方，尤其是晚饭的时候。

part1.en: Is there anything you don't like about your home?
part1.zh: 你家有什么你不喜欢的地方吗？

part1.en: The lift is often broken, so sometimes I have to walk up ten floors, which is really tiring.
part1.zh: 电梯经常坏，所以有时我得爬十层楼，真的很累。

part1.en: Would you prefer to live in a house or a flat in the future?
part1.zh: 以后你更想住独栋房子还是公寓？

part1.en: I'd prefer a house with a garden, because I'd love to have a dog and grow some vegetables.
part1.zh: 我更想住带花园的房子，因为我想养一只狗，还想种点蔬菜。

part2.prompt: 描述一张照片：一家人在家里的客厅。说说每个人在做什么、房间里有什么、气氛怎么样。

sentences.en: In this picture, I can see three people in a living room at home.
sentences.zh: 这张照片里，我能看到三个人在家里的客厅。

sentences.en: A man is sitting on a grey sofa reading a newspaper, and he looks very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 一个男人坐在灰色沙发上看报纸，看起来很舒服。

sentences.en: On the carpet, a little girl is playing with a black cat and a piece of string.
sentences.zh: 地毯上，一个小女孩正拿着一根绳子逗一只黑猫玩。

sentences.en: Near the window, a woman is watering some plants.
sentences.zh: 窗户旁边，一个女人正在给植物浇水。

sentences.en: There is a big bookshelf full of books, and a lamp next to the sofa.
sentences.zh: 有一个摆满书的大书架，沙发旁边还有一盏台灯。

sentences.en: There are some family photos on the wall, and the TV in the corner is switched off.
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着几张全家福，角落里的电视是关着的。

sentences.en: The girl is wearing pyjamas, so it is probably the morning or the evening.
sentences.zh: 小女孩穿着睡衣，所以可能是早上或者晚上。

sentences.en: Everything looks clean and tidy, and the colours in the room are warm.
sentences.zh: 一切看起来都干净整洁，房间的色调很温暖。

sentences.en: I think it is a quiet moment at home, and everyone seems relaxed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是家里一个安静的时刻，每个人都很放松。

part3.task: **Part 3** 你和另一位考生看一张任务卡:一家人想利用家里的空房间。讨论卡片上的用途(书房、客房、小健身房、游戏室、储物间),说说他们选哪个最合适 —— 可以各有偏好,不需要选同一个。

sentences.en: This family wants to use their empty room, and these are the ideas. What do you think they should do?
sentences.zh: 这家人想利用家里的空房间，这些是备选方案。你觉得他们该怎么用？

sentences.en: Well, a study would be really useful. The children would have a quiet place to do their homework.
sentences.zh: 嗯，书房会很实用。孩子们就有一个安静的地方写作业了。

sentences.en: That's true, but they probably do their homework at the kitchen table already, and that works fine.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过他们大概已经习惯在餐桌上写作业了，那样也挺好。

sentences.en: OK. Then what about a guest room? The grandparents could stay when they visit.
sentences.zh: 好吧。那客房怎么样？爷爷奶奶来的时候可以住。

sentences.en: Grandparents usually only visit a few times a year, though, so the room would be empty most of the time.
sentences.zh: 可爷爷奶奶通常一年只来几次，房间大部分时间会空着。

sentences.en: Good point. A small gym could be nice, with a bike and some weights.
sentences.zh: 有道理。弄个小健身房也不错，放一辆健身车和几个哑铃。

sentences.en: It's hard to say if they would use it. Not every family likes exercise!
sentences.zh: 很难说他们会不会用。不是每家人都喜欢锻炼！

sentences.en: Ha! Then a games room might be more popular, with a big screen and some comfortable chairs.
sentences.zh: 哈！那游戏室可能更受欢迎，配个大屏幕和几把舒服的椅子。

sentences.en: The children would love that, but the parents will probably say it's a waste of space.
sentences.zh: 孩子们会很喜欢，但父母大概会说这是浪费空间。

sentences.en: Maybe, but the last option, using it just for storage, sounds a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，不过最后一个选项，只拿来当储物间，听起来有点无聊。

sentences.en: I agree. Honestly, I still think the games room would make everyone happiest.
sentences.zh: 同意。说实话，我还是觉得游戏室会让大家最开心。

sentences.en: And I'd still choose the study. Let's suggest both ideas and let the family decide.
sentences.zh: 而我还是会选书房。我们把两个想法都提出来，让这家人决定吧。

topics.title: 聊聊运动
topics.subtitle: Sports and exercise
topics.examTip:
**考法** 运动是 PET 口语 Part 1 的高频话题：考官会问你做不做运动、更喜欢参与还是观看、想尝试什么新运动、以后会不会多做运动。回答要用完整句并给理由或例子，通常会自然用到频率表达（twice a week）、比较结构（prefer … to …）、would like to 和将来表达（I'll / I want to）。像「年轻人运动量够不够」这类社会性观点题更常出现在 Part 4。
**场景** Part 2 的照片常是人们在运动的场面，先说整体场景，再说人物动作和衣着，最后补场地和周围物品。考场上考官只说 Please tell us what you can see in the photograph，没有分项小问题，要自己按顺序说满约一分钟。Part 3 常见任务卡是学校想让学生多运动，要比较几种活动的优缺点、中途征询对方意见，向一个结论推进但不用急着决定。

templates.en: I ___ about ___ times a week, usually ___.
templates.zh: 说运动频率和时间

templates.en: I prefer ___ to ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 比较两种运动并给理由

templates.en: I've never tried ___, but I'd like to.
templates.zh: 说没试过但想尝试的运动

templates.en: The best thing about playing in a team is ___.
templates.zh: 说团队运动的好处

part1.en: Do you do any sport?
part1.zh: 你做运动吗？

part1.en: Yes, I play badminton twice a week at a sports centre near my school, and I sometimes go running in the park.
part1.zh: 做，我每周在学校附近的体育中心打两次羽毛球，有时也去公园跑步。

part1.en: Do you prefer playing sport or watching it?
part1.zh: 你更喜欢做运动还是看比赛？

part1.en: Playing, definitely, because when I watch a match on TV I just want to get up and move.
part1.zh: 肯定是做运动，因为我在电视上看比赛时，只想站起来动一动。

part1.en: Is there a sport you would like to try in the future?
part1.zh: 以后有没有想尝试的运动？

part1.en: I'd like to try climbing, because a new climbing centre has opened in my town and my friends say it's exciting.
part1.zh: 我想试试攀岩，因为我们镇上新开了一家攀岩馆，朋友们说很刺激。

part1.en: Do you think you'll do more sport in the future?
part1.zh: 你觉得以后你会多做运动吗？

part1.en: I hope so. I've got a lot of exams this year, so I don't have much time, but next summer I want to start swimming again.
part1.zh: 希望吧。今年我考试很多，没多少时间，不过明年夏天我想重新开始游泳。

part2.prompt: 描述一张照片：一群年轻人在打篮球。说说他们在哪里、在做什么、穿什么、周围有什么。

sentences.en: In this picture, there are some teenagers playing basketball on an outdoor court.
sentences.zh: 这张照片里，有几个青少年在室外球场打篮球。

sentences.en: A girl in a red shirt is jumping up and throwing the ball towards the basket.
sentences.zh: 一个穿红色球衣的女孩正跳起来把球投向篮筐。

sentences.en: Two players in blue are trying to stop her.
sentences.zh: 两个穿蓝色球衣的球员正试图拦住她。

sentences.en: It looks like a warm day, because everyone is wearing shorts and T-shirts.
sentences.zh: 看起来天气挺暖和，因为大家都穿着短裤和T恤。

sentences.en: Behind the court, there is a tall fence and a row of trees.
sentences.zh: 球场后面有一道高高的围栏和一排树。

sentences.en: Some students are sitting on a bench at the side, watching the game and holding water bottles.
sentences.zh: 几个学生坐在场边的长椅上看比赛，手里拿着水瓶。

sentences.en: On the ground, I can see a few bags and a jacket that someone has taken off.
sentences.zh: 地上我能看到几个包，还有一件有人脱下来的外套。

sentences.en: The court is dark green with white lines, and the basket is on a metal pole.
sentences.zh: 球场是深绿色的，画着白线，篮筐装在一根金属杆上。

sentences.en: Everyone looks very focused, so I think it's an important game for them.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很专注，所以我觉得这对他们来说是场重要的比赛。

part3.task: **Part 3** 你和另一位考生看一张任务卡:学校想让学生多运动。讨论卡片上的活动(早上跑步俱乐部、放学后舞蹈或瑜伽课、班级运动比赛、周末远足、午休开放体育馆),说说哪个最有效 —— 比较优缺点,向结论推进。

sentences.en: The school wants students to do more exercise, and these are the ideas. Which one do you think would work best?
sentences.zh: 学校想让学生多运动，这些是备选方案。你觉得哪个效果最好？

sentences.en: A running club before school sounds healthy, but I'm not sure many people would get up early for it.
sentences.zh: 早上上课前的跑步俱乐部听起来很健康，但我不确定有多少人愿意为此早起。

sentences.en: I agree. Most of us are already tired in the morning. Dance or yoga classes after school might be more popular.
sentences.zh: 同意。我们大多数人早上本来就够累了。放学后的舞蹈或瑜伽课可能更受欢迎。

sentences.en: That's a nice idea, especially for people who don't like team sports.
sentences.zh: 这个主意不错，尤其适合不喜欢团队运动的人。

sentences.en: What about a sports competition between classes every month? Do you think people would join in?
sentences.zh: 每个月办一次班级之间的运动比赛怎么样？你觉得大家会参加吗？

sentences.en: That could be fun, but only the good players would take part, and the others would just watch.
sentences.zh: 可能会很有趣，但只有打得好的人会参加，其他人只是看。

sentences.en: True. Weekend hikes would get everyone walking, and you don't need to be good at anything.
sentences.zh: 没错。周末远足能让每个人都走起来，而且不需要擅长什么。

sentences.en: I like hiking, though not everyone can come at the weekend because of family plans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢远足，不过不是每个人周末都能来，家里可能有安排。

sentences.en: The last idea is opening the sports hall at lunchtime, so people can play whenever they want.
sentences.zh: 最后一个想法是午休时开放体育馆，大家想打球随时可以去。

sentences.en: That's the simplest one, and it doesn't cost the school anything.
sentences.zh: 这是最简单的一个，而且学校不用花一分钱。

sentences.en: So maybe the best plan is opening the hall at lunchtime, plus a dance or yoga class after school.
sentences.zh: 所以最好的方案也许是午休开放体育馆，再加一门放学后的舞蹈或瑜伽课。

sentences.en: Yes, I think those two together would get the most students moving.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得这两样加起来能让最多的学生动起来。

topics.title: 聊聊交通出行
topics.subtitle: Getting around town
topics.examTip:
**考法** 交通出行在 PET 口语 Part 1 很常见：考官会问你平时怎么上学、更喜欢火车还是汽车、你的城市出行方不方便，也可能问你有没有长途旅行的经历。回答要完整并给理由，通常会自然用到 by + 交通工具、It takes …、比较级和现在完成时（Have you ever …?）。
**场景** Part 2 的照片可能是车站、公交站或街道，要说清人物、动作、天气和周围环境，多用方位词组织。考场上考官只说 Please tell us what you can see in the photograph，没有分项小问题，要自己按顺序说满约一分钟。Part 3 常见任务卡是几个人出行选交通方式，卡片说的是别人的情况，要用 they could… 来讨论，比较时间、价钱、舒适度并给理由，中途征询对方意见，向结论推进。

templates.en: I usually get to ___ by ___, and it takes about ___ minutes.
templates.zh: 说日常交通方式和用时

templates.en: I'd rather take ___ than ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 比较两种交通方式并给理由

templates.en: The worst thing about ___ is ___.
templates.zh: 说某种交通方式最糟糕的地方

templates.en: In my city, the ___ is ___, but the ___ is often ___.
templates.zh: 评价城市的交通状况

part1.en: How do you usually travel to school?
part1.zh: 你平时怎么去上学？

part1.en: I take the underground, and then I walk for about ten minutes. It's crowded, but it's much faster than the bus.
part1.zh: 我坐地铁，然后再走大约十分钟。地铁很挤，但比公交车快多了。

part1.en: Which do you prefer, travelling by train or by car?
part1.zh: 你更喜欢坐火车还是坐汽车出行？

part1.en: I prefer the train, because I can read or sleep, and I don't have to worry about traffic.
part1.zh: 我更喜欢火车，因为可以看书或睡觉，也不用担心堵车。

part1.en: Is it easy to get around your town?
part1.zh: 在你们城市出行方便吗？

part1.en: Yes, mostly. There are lots of buses and shared bikes, but the traffic is terrible in the evening.
part1.zh: 大体上方便。有很多公交车和共享单车，不过傍晚的交通很糟糕。

part1.en: Have you ever been on a long journey?
part1.zh: 你有过长途旅行的经历吗？

part1.en: Yes, last summer I took a high-speed train to Beijing with my family, and I loved having time to read and chat on the way.
part1.zh: 有，去年夏天我和家人坐高铁去北京，一路上有时间看书聊天，我很喜欢。

part2.prompt: 描述一张照片：一个公交车站。说说有哪些人、他们在做什么、天气怎么样、周围有什么。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a bus stop on a busy street in a city.
sentences.zh: 照片里，我能看到城市里一条繁忙街道上的公交车站。

sentences.en: Four or five people are waiting under a small shelter, and a red bus is just arriving.
sentences.zh: 四五个人在一个小候车亭下等车，一辆红色公交车正好进站。

sentences.en: It is raining, so most of them are holding umbrellas or wearing raincoats.
sentences.zh: 天在下雨，所以他们大多数人打着伞或穿着雨衣。

sentences.en: A young man at the front is looking at his phone.
sentences.zh: 最前面的一个年轻男人正在看手机。

sentences.en: Next to him, an older woman is carrying two shopping bags and a black umbrella.
sentences.zh: 他旁边，一位年长的女士拎着两个购物袋，撑着一把黑伞。

sentences.en: Behind the shelter, there are some tall buildings and a shop with bright lights.
sentences.zh: 候车亭后面有几栋高楼和一家灯光明亮的商店。

sentences.en: The road is wet, and I can see the lights of some cars in the distance.
sentences.zh: 路面是湿的，远处我能看到一些汽车的车灯。

sentences.en: There is a rubbish bin and a timetable on a pole next to the shelter.
sentences.zh: 候车亭旁边有一个垃圾桶，还有一根杆子上挂着时刻表。

sentences.en: I think it is the evening after work, and everyone wants to get home quickly.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是下班后的傍晚，大家都想快点回家。

part3.task: **Part 3** 你和另一位考生看一张任务卡:六个朋友周六要去邻近城市玩一天。讨论卡片上的交通方式(火车、长途汽车、请家长开车、骑自行车),说说他们选哪种最合适 —— 比较时间、价钱和舒适度。

sentences.en: Six friends are going to Suzhou for the day on Saturday. How should they travel there?
sentences.zh: 六个朋友周六要去苏州玩一天。他们该怎么去呢？

sentences.en: The train is the obvious choice. It only takes about an hour, and it's never late.
sentences.zh: 火车是显而易见的选择。只要大约一个小时，而且从不晚点。

sentences.en: It's quite expensive for six people, though. The coach is much cheaper.
sentences.zh: 不过六个人坐火车挺贵的。长途汽车便宜多了。

sentences.en: That's true, but the coach can get stuck in traffic, and someone always feels sick on it.
sentences.zh: 确实，但长途汽车可能会堵在路上，而且总有人坐车会晕。

sentences.en: What if one of their parents drives them? Then they could stop wherever they want. What do you think?
sentences.zh: 要不请其中一位家长开车送他们？这样想在哪儿停就在哪儿停。你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Six people won't fit in one car, and a parent probably doesn't want to spend a whole Saturday driving.
sentences.zh: 六个人一辆车坐不下，而且家长大概也不想把整个周六花在开车上。

sentences.en: Fair point. Cycling would be an adventure, but it's about eighty kilometres.
sentences.zh: 有道理。骑车去会是一次冒险，可路程大约有八十公里。

sentences.en: Eighty kilometres! They'd arrive too tired to do anything.
sentences.zh: 八十公里！到了他们就累得什么都干不了了。

sentences.en: OK, so it's really between the train and the coach.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那其实就是在火车和长途汽车之间选了。

sentences.en: If they book early, the train tickets will be cheaper, and they'll have more time in the city.
sentences.zh: 如果早点订票，火车票会更便宜，他们在城里的时间也会更多。

sentences.en: That's a good point. More time there matters more than saving a little money.
sentences.zh: 说得好。在那儿多待一会儿比省一点钱更重要。

sentences.en: So we both think the train is the best choice for them.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都觉得，火车对他们来说是最好的选择。

topics.title: 聊聊节日庆祝
topics.subtitle: Celebrations and special days
topics.examTip:
**考法** 节日与庆祝是 PET 口语 Part 1 的常见话题：考官会问你最喜欢哪个节日、怎么过生日、去年有没有特别的庆祝；Part 1 末尾或 Part 4 也可能问节日对家庭重不重要。回答要用完整句并给理由或例子，通常会自然用到一般现在时说习惯、一般过去时说去年的经历，以及 because / so / which 这样的连接方式。
**场景** Part 2 的照片常是生日派对或节日聚会，要说清人物、动作、桌上和周围的物品，再简短说气氛。考场上考官只说 Please tell us what you can see in the photograph，没有分项小问题，要自己按顺序说满约一分钟。Part 3 常见任务卡是策划一次节日或庆祝活动，要逐个比较选项、回应对方并给理由；意见不一致时可以让步（if most people prefer…, that's fine too）或提出两个方案一起提交。

templates.en: My favourite festival is ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说最喜欢的节日并给理由

templates.en: During ___, we usually ___ and ___.
templates.zh: 说节日里通常做的事

templates.en: Last year we ___, which was ___.
templates.zh: 用过去时说去年的庆祝经历

templates.en: For my birthday, I'd like to ___ rather than ___.
templates.zh: 说生日想怎么过、不想怎么过

part1.en: Which festival do you enjoy most, and why?
part1.zh: 你最喜欢哪个节日？为什么？

part1.en: Spring Festival, definitely. My relatives all come to my grandma's house, and we cook and eat together for days.
part1.zh: 肯定是春节。亲戚们都会来我奶奶家，我们一连好几天一起做饭、吃饭。

part1.en: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
part1.zh: 你通常怎么过生日？

part1.en: I usually invite a few close friends round, and we order pizza and watch a film together.
part1.zh: 我通常会请几个好朋友来家里，我们点披萨，一起看电影。

part1.en: Did you do anything special last Spring Festival?
part1.zh: 去年春节你做了什么特别的事吗？

part1.en: Yes, we visited my aunt in the countryside, and we set off fireworks by the river, which was amazing.
part1.zh: 有，我们去乡下看了我姑姑，还在河边放烟花，特别棒。

part1.en: Do you think festivals are important for families?
part1.zh: 你觉得节日对家庭重要吗？

part1.en: Yes, I think so, because everyone is so busy during the year, and festivals give us time to relax and talk.
part1.zh: 我觉得重要，因为平时大家都很忙，节日给了我们放松和聊天的时间。

part2.prompt: 描述一张照片：一个户外生日聚会。说说有哪些人、在做什么、桌上有什么、气氛怎么样。

sentences.en: In the picture, I can see a birthday party in a garden on a sunny day.
sentences.zh: 照片里，我能看到一个晴天在花园里举行的生日聚会。

sentences.en: A girl of about ten is blowing out the candles on a big chocolate cake.
sentences.zh: 一个大约十岁的女孩正在吹灭一个大巧克力蛋糕上的蜡烛。

sentences.en: The girl is wearing a yellow dress, and she looks very excited.
sentences.zh: 女孩穿着黄色的裙子，看起来非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Around her, there are six or seven children wearing party hats, and they are all clapping.
sentences.zh: 她周围有六七个戴着派对帽的孩子，都在鼓掌。

sentences.en: On the table, there are some cups, crisps and sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 桌上有一些杯子、薯片和三明治。

sentences.en: There are colourful balloons tied to the chairs, and a banner that says Happy Birthday.
sentences.zh: 椅子上系着彩色的气球，还有一条写着生日快乐的横幅。

sentences.en: A woman on the left is taking a photo with her phone, and she is smiling.
sentences.zh: 左边一个女人正用手机拍照，她在微笑。

sentences.en: In the background, there is a wooden fence and a tree with a swing.
sentences.zh: 背景里有一道木栅栏和一棵挂着秋千的树。

sentences.en: I think it is a lovely afternoon, and everyone is having a great time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是个美好的下午，每个人都玩得很开心。

part3.task: **Part 3** 你和另一位考生看一张任务卡:学校要为交换生办一个中秋节晚会。讨论卡片上的活动(一起做月饼、制作灯笼、传统音乐表演、讲节日故事、户外赏月野餐),说说哪个最应该安排 —— 充分讨论,意见不同也没关系。

sentences.en: The school is planning a Mid-Autumn Festival evening for the exchange students. Which activities should we include?
sentences.zh: 学校打算为交换生办一个中秋节晚会。我们应该安排哪些活动？

sentences.en: Making mooncakes together would be great. Everyone loves food, and it's easy to join in.
sentences.zh: 一起做月饼会很棒。大家都喜欢吃的，而且容易参与。

sentences.en: True, but the kitchen is small, and thirty people can't cook at the same time.
sentences.zh: 确实，不过厨房很小，三十个人没法同时做。

sentences.en: OK, then what about a lantern workshop? People could make their own and carry them outside later.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那灯笼工坊怎么样？大家可以自己做，之后提着到外面去。

sentences.en: I like that. It's creative, and the lanterns would look beautiful in the dark.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢。有创意，而且灯笼在黑暗里会很好看。

sentences.en: We could also ask the music club to play some traditional songs.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以请音乐社演奏几首传统曲子。

sentences.en: That sounds nice, though a whole concert might be a bit long for people who don't know the music.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错，不过对不了解这些音乐的人来说，整场音乐会可能有点长。

sentences.en: Maybe just two or three songs, then. And someone could tell the story behind the festival.
sentences.zh: 那就只演两三首吧。还可以请人讲讲这个节日背后的故事。

sentences.en: Yes, a short story would help the exchange students understand why we celebrate it.
sentences.zh: 对，一个简短的故事能帮交换生明白我们为什么过这个节。

sentences.en: The last idea is a picnic outside to look at the moon. That's what the festival is really about.
sentences.zh: 最后一个想法是到户外野餐赏月。这才是这个节日真正的意义。

sentences.en: I'd put the picnic first, because it's the most relaxed way for everyone to talk.
sentences.zh: 我会把野餐排第一，因为那是让大家聊天最放松的方式。

sentences.en: I'd choose the lanterns, because people can take something home. But if most people prefer the picnic, that's fine too.
sentences.zh: 我会选灯笼，因为大家能带点东西回家。不过要是大多数人更喜欢野餐，那也挺好。

topics.title: 聊聊朋友
topics.subtitle: Friends and friendship
topics.examTip:
**考法** 朋友是 PET 口语 Part 1 的高频话题：考官常请你介绍一位好朋友、说说你们一起做什么、交新朋友容不容易；Part 1 末尾或 Part 4 也可能问朋友多重不重要。回答要用完整句并给理由或例子，通常会自然用到现在完成时（we've been friends for …）、一般现在时说习惯，以及 because / but / once 这样的连接方式。
**场景** Part 2 的照片可能是朋友在咖啡馆、公园或家里相处的场面，先说人物和动作，再说桌上物品和周围环境，最后简短推测关系和心情。考场上考官只说 Please tell us what you can see in the photograph，没有分项小问题，要自己按顺序说满约一分钟。Part 3 常见任务卡是朋友搬走后怎么保持联系，要比较几种方式的优缺点，回应对方并向结论推进。

templates.en: My best friend is called ___, and we met ___.
templates.zh: 介绍好朋友和认识的经过

templates.en: We get on well because we both ___.
templates.zh: 说合得来的原因

templates.en: A good friend should be ___ and ___.
templates.zh: 说好朋友应有的品质

templates.en: We keep in touch by ___, and we ___ once a ___.
templates.zh: 说保持联系的方式和频率

part1.en: Tell us about a good friend of yours.
part1.zh: 说说你的一个好朋友吧。

part1.en: My best friend is Kevin. We met in primary school, and we've been friends for nearly eight years.
part1.zh: 我最好的朋友叫 Kevin。我们是在小学认识的，做朋友已经快八年了。

part1.en: What do you usually do together?
part1.zh: 你们平时一起做什么？

part1.en: We play basketball after school, and at the weekend we often go to the cinema or just chat at his place.
part1.zh: 放学后我们一起打篮球，周末常去看电影，或者就在他家聊天。

part1.en: Do you find it easy to make new friends?
part1.zh: 你觉得交新朋友容易吗？

part1.en: Not really, because I'm quite quiet when I meet new people, but once I know someone I talk a lot.
part1.zh: 不太容易，因为我刚认识新人时挺安静的，不过一旦熟了我话就很多。

part1.en: Do you think it's important to have a lot of friends?
part1.zh: 你觉得朋友多重要吗？

part1.en: No, I don't think so. Two or three close friends you can trust are better than a hundred people you hardly know.
part1.zh: 不，我不这么认为。两三个可以信任的好朋友，胜过一百个不太熟的人。

part2.prompt: 描述一张照片：两个朋友在咖啡馆。说说她们在做什么、桌上有什么、周围环境怎么样。

sentences.en: In this picture, two girls are sitting at a small table in a café.
sentences.zh: 这张照片里，两个女孩坐在咖啡馆的一张小桌旁。

sentences.en: One girl is showing the other something on her phone, and her friend is laughing.
sentences.zh: 一个女孩正给另一个看手机上的东西，她的朋友在笑。

sentences.en: They both have a coffee, and there is a piece of cake in the middle of the table.
sentences.zh: 她们每人面前有一杯咖啡，桌子中间还有一块蛋糕。

sentences.en: The girl on the right has curly hair and is wearing a white jumper.
sentences.zh: 右边的女孩留着卷发，穿着白色毛衣。

sentences.en: Behind them, there is a big window, and I can see people walking past in the street.
sentences.zh: 她们身后有一扇大窗户，我能看到街上有人走过。

sentences.en: The café looks small and cosy, with wooden tables and some plants on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆看起来小而温馨，有木桌，架子上还摆着一些植物。

sentences.en: On the wall, there is a blackboard with the menu written on it.
sentences.zh: 墙上有一块写着菜单的小黑板。

sentences.en: It looks like a cloudy afternoon, because the light outside is quite soft.
sentences.zh: 看起来是个多云的下午，因为外面的光线很柔和。

sentences.en: I think they are close friends, and they are enjoying their time together.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她们是很要好的朋友，正享受在一起的时光。

part3.task: **Part 3** 你和另一位考生看一张任务卡:好朋友 Lucy 要搬去另一个城市。讨论卡片上保持联系的办法(每周视频通话、建群聊、假期互访、写信寄明信片、线上一起看电影),说说哪个最好 —— 回应对方的想法并给理由。

sentences.en: Lucy is moving to Shanghai next month. How can we make sure we stay in touch with her?
sentences.zh: Lucy 下个月要搬去上海了。我们怎么才能保证和她保持联系？

sentences.en: A video call every week would be a good place to start. You can see her face and really talk.
sentences.zh: 每周一次视频通话会是个不错的起点。能看到她的脸，真正聊聊天。

sentences.en: I agree, though we'd have to find a time that works for everyone, because she'll be busy at her new school.
sentences.zh: 同意，不过得找一个大家都方便的时间，因为她在新学校会很忙。

sentences.en: That's true. A group chat is easier, because people can send messages whenever they're free.
sentences.zh: 没错。群聊更方便，因为大家有空时随时都能发消息。

sentences.en: Yes, but group chats go quiet after a few weeks. Everyone just sends stickers.
sentences.zh: 是的，但群聊几周后就会冷下来。大家只发表情包。

sentences.en: Ha, that's exactly what happens! Visiting her in the holidays would be more special.
sentences.zh: 哈，还真是这样！假期去看她会更特别。

sentences.en: Definitely, and Shanghai is only an hour away by train, so it's not difficult.
sentences.zh: 当然，而且上海坐火车只要一个小时，不难。

sentences.en: What about writing letters or sending postcards? It's old-fashioned, but it's fun to get real post.
sentences.zh: 写信或者寄明信片怎么样？虽然老派，但收到真正的信很有意思。

sentences.en: I like that, but honestly I'd forget to write after the first one.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢，但说实话写完第一封我就会忘了。

sentences.en: Fair enough. Watching a film online together at the same time could be fun too.
sentences.zh: 也是。约好同一时间在线一起看一部电影也可能很有意思。

sentences.en: That could work too, if everyone is free at the same time. So a weekly video call plus holiday visits seems best.
sentences.zh: 那也行，只要大家能在同一时间有空。所以每周一次视频通话，加上假期去看她，似乎最好。

sentences.en: I agree, and we can keep the group chat for everyday things in between.
sentences.zh: 同意，平时的小事我们就用群聊。
